title: Almost perfect pixel art asset generation
author: Rsloth
selftext: AI pixel art generation is 99% there with MagicPixel, a few pixels off here and there but easily fixed. All aligned to the pixel grid, color shiftable in two clicks. Best results for generating variants if starting with a clean asset.
